paint.title: PAINT SHOP
paint.text: A new paint job every 100 cleared hills. Paint is cosmetic and never changes the odds.
fair.title: PROVABLY FAIR
fair.intro: Every hill is decided when you press GAS at a checkpoint: HMAC_SHA256(server_seed, client_seed:nonce:hill), bytes 0-3 → u. u ≥ chance is a crash (its lethal part splits into flip / empty tank), otherwise u ÷ chance picks how the hill looks. You see the SHA-256 of the server seed now and the seed itself when you rotate.
rules.title: HOW TO PLAY
rules.intro: Hill Climb Rush is a step crash game over {levels} hills. Place a bet, pick a vehicle and hold GAS. Every checkpoint you reach raises the multiplier; at a checkpoint you can PULL OVER to cash out or hold GAS for the next hill. A crash — a flip onto the roof or an empty tank — ends the round and the bet is lost. Reach the summit to win the top multiplier automatically.
rules.controls_text: Hold GAS (right pedal, → or D) to drive and to pitch the nose up in the air. BRAKE (left pedal, ← or A) slows down and pitches the nose down. C pulls over at a checkpoint. On a phone use both thumbs.
rules.step: Each hill: multiplier = previous × 1 / chance. Before a hill you see its exact chance and the multiplier you will reach. The vehicle sets the risk.
rules.crashes_text: A crash is a flip onto the roof ({flip}% of crashes, Neck Snap) or an empty tank before the crest ({fuel}%). Both lose the round; only the Jerrycan helps, and only against an empty tank.
rules.tricks_text: Optional bets on how the next hill goes. They settle on that hill only and pay stake × odds straight to your credit, whatever happens to the round. Odds = RTP ÷ probability on that hill, rounded down (RTP {rtp}), so they change from hill to hill and vehicle to vehicle.
rules.can_text: From hill {n} you can buy a jerrycan for the next hill. If the tank runs dry on that hill, the jerrycan restarts the engine: you keep {keep}% of your multiplier and drive the same hill again. It does not help against a flip. Price = chance of an empty tank × the value it saves (RTP {rtp}).
rules.can_limit: This casino allows {n} save(s) per round.
rules.can_off: The jerrycan is not offered by this casino.
rules.rtp_text: Theoretical RTP of the main bet: {rtp} for any cash-out strategy (multipliers are rounded to 0.01). Maximum win {max}× bet. Every hill is decided by HMAC-SHA256 of the server seed (its hash is shown before you play), your client seed, the round nonce and the hill number — see FAIR.
rules.physics: The pedals drive the ride, not the result. Gas and brake change the speed and the pitch of the vehicle, but whether it makes the next checkpoint — and how — is fixed by the fair hash when you press GAS at the checkpoint. The driving physics then plays that result.
rules.malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays. An unfinished round is kept and restored the next time you open the game.
